fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Combustion + Subcritical Rankine Cycle with Drum Thermal ODE
source: Black & Veatch (1996), Power Plant Engineering, Chapman & Hall; El-Wakil (1984), Powerplant Technology, McGraw-Hill; Borgnakke & Sonntag (2009), Fundamentals of Thermodynamics 7th ed.; IAPWS-IF97 (Wagner et al., 2000) simplified correlations; IEA Clean Coal Centre CCC/168 (2010).

unit.name: Generic 500 MW Subcritical PC Plant (540 C / 165 bar, single reheat)

LHV_coal.note: Bituminous coal lower heating value; range 23-29 MJ/kg (Black & Veatch Table)

coal_carbon_fraction.note: Mass fraction of carbon in bituminous coal

excess_air_fraction.note: Fraction of air above stoichiometric (~20% typical PC)

T_stack_c.note: Flue gas stack temperature (above acid dew point ~120C)

T_air_in_c.note: Combustion air inlet (after air heater datum)

cp_flue_kj_kgK.note: Mean specific heat of flue gas

eta_turbine_isen.note: Isentropic efficiency of steam turbine (HP+IP+LP lumped)

feedwater_temp_c.note: Final feedwater temperature after regenerative heaters (~250C for 165 bar plant)

regen_bleed_fraction.note: Total fraction of throttle steam bled to feedwater heaters (reduces LP work)

aux_power_frac.note: Auxiliary load (fans, mills, pumps) as fraction of gross (~7%)

drum_metal_mass_kg.note: Drum + riser/downcomer metal + water inventory lumped thermal mass

drum_cp_kj_kgK.note: Effective lumped heat capacity of drum metal+water mixture

drum_UA_kw_K.note: Effective heat-transfer conductance furnace->drum working fluid
